Title: NETMESSAGE:Perhaps some answers can be found here.\nThat symbol looks familiar...
Translation: 也许这里能找到一些答案。\n那个符号看起来很熟悉...

Title: NETMESSAGE:This is the journal of a scientist who worked here.
Translation: 这是一位曾在这里工作的科学家的日记。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A secret laboratory hidden within the city.
Translation: 一个隐藏在城内的秘密实验室。

Title: NETMESSAGE:It seems they were doing tests on an unidentified red material.
Translation: 看来他们正在对一种未知的红色物质进行测试。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The final puzzle pieces have been found.\nThe research chamber is accessable...
Translation: 最后的拼图碎片已找到。\n研究舱已可进入...

Title: NETMESSAGE:The red puzzle piece has been found!
Translation: 红色拼图碎片已找到！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The green puzzle piece has been found!
Translation: 绿色拼图碎片已找到！

Title: NETMESSAGE:According to this journal, these scientists\nhave been working on interdimensional gateways.
Translation: 根据这本日记，这些科学家\n一直在研究跨维度门户。

Title: NETMESSAGE:'Forgot my access card so I cant get into the Labs...\nI dont mind though. Just looking at that red stuff gives me a headache.'
Translation: '我忘了门禁卡所以进不了实验室...\n不过我不在乎。光是看那红色东西就让我头疼。'

Title: NETMESSAGE:The blue puzzle piece has been found!
Translation: 蓝色拼图碎片已找到！

Title: NETMESSAGE:This world seems to be devoid of any life.\nApart from these huge stone towers,\nthere is little of interest here.
Translation: 这个世界似乎没有任何生命。\n除了这些巨大的石塔，\n这里没什么值得关注的。
